name: Foreach
description: Iterate over an input collection either by executing in-canvas nodes or a child graph, with sync or async dispatch.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Execution Mode
inputs.helpText: In-Canvas runs connected nodes directly on this board. Child Subgraph invokes a separate saved graph.

inputs.name: executionType
inputs.label: Execution Type
inputs.helpText: Synchronous waits for all items to complete and aggregates results. Child graphs with human gates require synchronous execution and concurrency 1. Asynchronous dispatches iterations without blocking the parent run.

inputs.name: items
inputs.label: Items
inputs.helpText: Array of items or an object containing an items array.

inputs.name: baseInput
inputs.label: Base Input
inputs.helpText: Optional base object passed to every item run. Note: 'item', 'index', and 'total' are reserved and automatically generated.

inputs.name: maxIterations
inputs.label: Max Iterations
inputs.helpText: Maximum number of items to process (1 to 100).

inputs.name: concurrency
inputs.label: Concurrency
inputs.helpText: Number of executions to run in parallel (1 to 10). Set to 1 when a child graph can ask for human input.

inputs.name: stopOnError
inputs.label: Stop On Error
inputs.helpText: If enabled, stops initiating new runs after the first failure.

inputs.name: outputType
inputs.label: Child / Iteration Output Type
inputs.helpText: Describes item result for downstream autocomplete.
